business_problem: SOLAS needed a better way to answer repetitive fetchcourses.ie support questions so adult learners could get immediate help without tying up scarce IT staff on simple issues.
solution_summary: SOLAS worked with SureSkills, Education and Training Boards Ireland and Ludex to build "Dave," a virtual assistant on fetchcourses.ie using IBM watsonx Assistant. The team cataloged about 30 of the most common support and course-related questions, then prepared ten variants of each so the assistant could recognize different phrasings. Answers were written in plain English, tested iteratively and adjusted with attention to GDPR implications and handoff needs. In production, the assistant handles common problems such as forgotten passwords, duplicate accounts and other navigation questions directly on the site, while more complex cases are routed to the relevant human support path. The implementation acts as a front-door service layer for lifelong-learning support: website users ask for help, watsonx Assistant matches intent against the curated Q&A set, and SOLAS staff only intervene on exceptions that genuinely need specialist attention.

business_outcome: The assistant cut incoming support-query volume by 50%, saves potentially hundreds of staff hours annually and frees SOLAS specialists to focus on higher-value work while learners get quicker answers.
